ledger: woman with red bag (background) | walking away from camera across paved plaza at 00:00 | small, far up frame by ~00:03 then out of view as camera reframes | continuous forward walking 00:00-00:03, stride and recession plausible, no causal issue

phone held in hand (foreground) | out of focus, screen shows 'A742' at 00:00 | focus pulls onto phone ~00:03.25; phone lowered out of frame 00:09.25-00:09.75 revealing stairs | rack focus and lowering motion continuous; camera motion → background parallax plausible

findings.invariant_violated: light change without cause / temporal continuity
findings.description: The large bright sunlight patch on the phone screen flickers on and off and jumps location between consecutive 1/12-s samples (e.g. present 00:06.5, absent 00:06.75, present 00:07.0, absent 00:07.25-00:07.75, present 00:08.0, absent 00:08.25) while the phone, hand and camera are essentially stationary and no occluding object is visible; only the small thumb moves, which cannot account for a shadow edge spanning half the screen. Same on/off strip flicker is visible at lower scale during 00:01-00:03.
